main.description: Create one of the requester's private audiences, held by this AppView and never written to a repository. The AppView mints the record key (a TID). The audience is readable by the read rule as soon as the answer comes back, except a member's first private row, whose posts wait for the member's indexing. Requires auth by a ready community member.

record.description: A tools.kryphocron.policy.audience record. $type: absent, or tools.kryphocron.policy.audience. mode: absent or null (read as list), or one of list, everyone, followers, following, nobody. name: absent or null, or a string of 1 to 64 graphemes and at most 640 bytes once trimmed of white space; stored trimmed. members: absent or null (none), or an array of DIDs of at most 256 bytes each; de-duplicated in order, the requester's own DID dropped, then at most 1000. createdAt and updatedAt: required datetimes. Other keys are not stored. The body is at most 512 KiB.

cid.description: An opaque version token for updateAudience's swapCid, not a CID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is not an object, carries an rkey (this AppView mints the record key), or its record fails a check above. The message says which.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
